header.title: Holiday price tag calculator
header.intro: Holiday spending on a card costs more than the receipt once interest adds up. See how much longer payoff could take, and what the holidays could really cost, at the same monthly payment.

demoBanner.strong: Illustrative only — not advice or an offer.
demoBanner.body: Uses the balance, APR, and payment you enter. Fees, rate changes, minimum-payment rules, and other new charges are not modeled.

newSpending.label: Holiday spending
newSpending.question: How much do you plan to spend on the holidays?

payment.label: Monthly payment
payment.question: How much do you pay each month?

results.heading: What the holidays really cost
results.invalidMessage: Fix the highlighted fields to see an estimate.
results.neverHeadline: At {{payment}} a month the balance would not go down. The payment needs to be more than one month's interest, about {{interest}}.
results.neverMessage: Try a higher monthly payment or a lower balance to see a payoff time.
results.zeroSpendHeadline: With no holiday spending, this balance could be paid off in {{duration}} with {{interest}} in interest.
results.headline: Your {{spending}} holiday could really cost {{trueCost}}, and take {{months}} longer to pay off at {{payment}} a month.
results.headlineSameTime: Your {{spending}} holiday could really cost {{trueCost}} at {{payment}} a month, without changing your payoff month.

labels.keepDate: Payment to keep your payoff date

results.chartAria: Card balance over time with and without the holiday spending
results.tip: The APR is the same on both lines. The holiday costs more because a bigger balance takes longer to pay off at the same payment. Paying about {{keep}} a month instead would keep your original payoff month.
results.tipNoKeep: The APR is the same on both lines. The holiday costs more because a bigger balance takes longer to pay off at the same payment.
results.summaryMessage: Assumes a fixed monthly payment, a constant APR, interest compounded monthly, and no charges beyond the holiday spending. Your actual payoff may differ.
results.cappedMessage: The estimate reached the {{years}}-year cap without paying the balance off.
